instruction: Please change the font of all text in the document to Arial.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font to Arial for all text. Evaluator checks that >= 95% of text runs have font name set to Arial (case-insensitive).
